disposition_reason: Section 2.1 prints average total mercury by whisky origin; all other elements are semi-quantitative signal intensities and not concentrations.

study.design: Multielemental fingerprinting of 20 whiskies by origin and type
study.origin: Scotland (Speyside, Highlands, Lowlands), Ireland, USA, per label
study.method: ICP-TOF-MS semi-quantitative signal intensities for 21 isotopes after microwave HNO3 digestion; total Hg by automatic mercury analyzer (thermal decomposition, CV AAS)
study.qa: Hg calibration 0-50 ng with L-cysteine standards; no reference material for whisky available

findings.notes: Average total mercury by direct thermal decomposition analyzer (triplicate 50 µL injections); number of samples per region not legible in the extracted Table 1. Per-litre result kept unconverted.
